item.title: High school schedule thaw leads to glut of games rest of week
item.description: Winter storm school closures have crammed Wilson-area high school basketball into a packed midweek schedule, with many games moved to Wednesday and Thursday and more wintry weather possibly affecting later dates.

item.title: CCS ROUNDUP: Community Christian girls score emotional win at Trinity
item.description: Community Christian hoops teams rolled at Trinity Christian, highlighted by an emotional girls OT comeback on a late supporter’s birthday, while boys and JV boys stayed perfect in MACAA play.

item.title: ‘We’re not worried’: Warbirds on schedule for inaugural season opener
item.description: With construction in its final stages, the Wilson Warbirds share some of the amenities at the new downtown ballpark, which they say will be ready for opening day April 14.

item.title: County reports first flu deaths of season
item.description: Two Wilson County residents in their 90s have died from flu-related causes, the county's first flu deaths this season, as local flu and RSV cases show a downward trend.

item.title: Rep. Greg Murphy meets with Wilson voters
item.description: Rep. Greg Murphy toured Wilson County, meeting voters and learning local priorities as the area prepares to join his 3rd Congressional District under North Carolina’s new map.

item.title: School board member honored for advocacy for exceptional children
item.description: Wilson County educator and school board member Debora Powell has received the N.C. School Boards Association’s Champion of Education Award for her decades of advocacy for exceptional children and public education.

item.title: Area Calendar, Jan. 29-30, 2026
item.description: Area sports calendar for Jan. 29-30, 2026: Barton College volleyball, swimming, track, softball, lacrosse and tennis, plus a full slate of local high school basketball across the region.

item.title: Choosing the path that’s right for you when success and recognition are no longer the goal
item.description: Former Duke goalkeeper E.J. Proctor reflects on Tim Ferriss’ questions about what you’d do without recognition or success, and how choosing those paths can guide more authentic life decisions.

item.title: Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week: Paris Best, Wilson Preparatory Academy
item.description: Wilson Prep sophomore guard Paris “Boogie” Best is the Farris & Thomas Law Student-Athlete of the Week after fueling an 11-game win streak while averaging 12.3 points and 6.7 assists in three victories.
